_about: What a game event shows the player, on any client. Edit and save: the next event uses it, no restart. Code: src/socket/ui-effects.js. Channels and why: docs/race-ui-channels.md.
_how: banner: a key from the client's string table, shown big in the centre for two seconds, and cut off past about 24 characters — the longest the game's own maps use. A list is tried in order and the first key this client can show is sent, so put a game key last as the fallback. Game keys work on every client: VICTORY, DUNGEON_FAILED (reads DEFEAT), DEFEAT_THE_RIVAL, 3_SECONDS_LEFT, TREASURE_FOUND, BOSS, COLLECT_TREASURE_GO.

strings: keys of this server's own, with their text. A client shows them only after `node tools/install-ui-strings.js <client bin directory>` has written them into it; every other client is sent the next key in the list instead, never `mia:KEY`. Run the tool again after changing them: new words show once it has; a new key falls back to the next in the list until then. Use names of your own: a game key here changes that text everywhere in the game.
A key built from a {param} must be one of the strings, or the next key in the list is used.
countdown: seconds, drawn by the game's own floor countdown (the one a party sees at a door), counting down by itself. Never in an infinite dungeon, whose client pays the floor out on it.
sound: a sound in the client's soundEffects.swf, e.g. LevelUp1, Lightning2, GenericHitSound, TEMP_Explosion3, TEMP_SwitchHit1b, GolemStomp.
shake: subtle | light | medium | heavy | rumble, or [frames, strength, count]. Name your own under 'shakes'.
zoom: below 1 pulls the camera back (the game uses 0.83); 'reset' returns it to 1.

floater: { amount, color } floats a number over the player's own hero; a negative amount is drawn as damage, a positive one as healing. color 0 is the client default; 11 poison, 12 fire, 13 cold, 14 blood, 15 bacon, 16 ethereal.
replacesChat: true sends no chat line for the event when its banner was shown.
to: self (the default) shows it to this player only; party shows it to everyone on the floor.

An event is named <mode>.<type>: a notice says its mode, and the ranked core's say none and are ranked's. One life has onelife.entered (the first floor's hero) and onelife.lost (the run lost), carrying nothing.

{name} in any value is filled from the event. Ranked notices carry: queued {waiting, ready}; paired {opponentRating, countdownSeconds}; progress {floor, of}; finished {rating, ratingChange}; cancelled {reason, requeued}. ranked.stands is walking out of the lobby's ring, and carries nothing. ranked.rival_seen is the first time a race shows the rival's ghost in the room, and carries nothing. ranked.draw_offered is the rival asking to call the race off (/draw), and carries nothing.
Only a dungeon floor can show banner, sound, shake, zoom and countdown; in town they are skipped. The ranked lobby is a floor, so all of them work there.

lines: the chat line each event says, as text the server sends — nothing to install, reworded here. Said unless a banner with replacesChat showed. {name} fills from the event, formatted for reading: a rating is a number from 0, a change reads +16, and {league} is the league the rating is in (server.defaults.json ranked.leagues). A finish also has {versus}, {why}, {times} and {moved} (a league crossed), a cancel {requeued}, the lobby's welcome {standing} and {how}: each is one of the parts. A line naming a param its event lacks is not said. Not every line is a core notice: ranked.welcome, ranked.cooldown and ranked.idle come from the stock-client adapter, and rank.* make up /rank.

lines._about: One chat line per event; the parts below fill its {versus}, {why}, {times}, {moved}, {requeued}, {standing} and {how}.
lines.ranked.queued: Ranked: in the ring, looking for an opponent ({waiting} waiting).
lines.ranked.stands: Ranked: in the stands: out of the queue. Walk into the skull ring to race.
lines.ranked.paired: Ranked: a rival ({opponentLeague} {opponentRating}) was found. Starting in {countdownSeconds} seconds.
lines.ranked.started: Ranked: go! Your clock is running.
lines.ranked.progress: Ranked: your opponent cleared floor {floor} of {of}.
lines.ranked.welcome: Ranked: you are {standing}. {how}; /rank shows the board.
lines.ranked.cooldown: Ranked: you can queue again in {seconds}s.
lines.ranked.idle: Ranked: you were idle, so you left the queue. Move to join it again.
lines.ranked.rival_seen: Ranked: your rival is in the room with you — a shade on your heels.
lines.ranked.draw_offered: Ranked: your rival offers to call the race off. /draw to agree: nobody's rating moves.
lines.onelife.entered: One life: no revives in this dungeon. A fall ends the run.
lines.onelife.lost: One life: your hero fell, and the run with it.
lines.delve.entered: Delve: boss after boss, each harder, until your party falls.
lines.delve.gift: Delve: {beaten} bosses beaten - {what} waits in town.
lines.delve.item: Delve: boss {beaten} dropped a {rarity} weapon, level {level}.
lines.delve.lost: Delve: your party fell at boss {depth}, {beaten} beaten.

parts._about: Pieces of the lines above, and of /rank. A part this book lacks is left out of its line.
parts.requeued: You are back in the queue.
parts.standing.unplaced: {league} {rating}, no place until your first race
parts.reward.gift: A gift of {what} waits in town.
parts.how.ring: Stand in the skull ring to race
parts.how.anywhere: Waiting here is waiting for a race
parts.rank.unreadable: the ranked board cannot be read right now
